Game Overview

Flappy Witch is a adventure title where fly as a daring witch through a spooky night, dodging eerie obstacles while collecting shimmering diamonds. Navigate with simple touch controls and experience escalating challenges, balancing the thrill of soaring high with the danger of a sudden crash in this engaging arcade adventure. Survive, collect, and conquer the sky!

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Flappy Witch is easy to pick up. Fly as a daring witch through a spooky night, dodging eerie obstacles while collecting shimmering diamonds. Navigate with simple touch controls and experience escalating challenges, balancing the thrill of soaring high with the danger of a sudden crash in this engaging arcade adventure. Survive, collect, and conquer the sky!
